entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered back on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It works fine. I just changed my mind.
I see. And you find you just don't use it as much as you'd planned?
It was an impulse buy. I just want to send it back.

Okay, I understand. For situations like this, we often recommend our official VeloFit resale marketplace. It’s a secure way for customers to sell their devices. But let me just double-check the formal return policy for your specific purchase date. Please hold.
A marketplace? So you're not going to help me. Figures.

No, not at all, I'm just reviewing the details... Ah, okay, thank you for your patience. I've just pulled up our main policy, and it looks like you are still well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now.
Oh. So you can do it. Fine.

Yes, of course. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on your account now. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original packaging and drop it at a UPS store.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the refund posted to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
